goal: Complete existing Fluxer desktop client parity

features.acceptance: Keyboard navigation, focus, screen reader semantics, reduced motion, contrast, scaling, text selection.
features.evidence: Native keyboard shortcuts and focus handling, selectable chat text, font sizing and a persisted reduced-motion preference. Screen-reader semantics, contrast and end-to-end keyboard review remain open. See REVIEW.md.

features.acceptance: Multi-account ownership, isolation, persisted inventories, switching and session lifecycle.
Native app shell, layouts, dialogs, launch lifecycle, instance capabilities and product flags.
features.evidence: Native client implementation and tests; see STATUS.md for scope and release gaps.

features.acceptance: Login, registration, unclaimed accounts, recovery, MFA, passkeys, SSO, verification and sudo.
features.evidence: Native sign-in and verification handoff, confirmed device revocation proofs and a native password reset request with browser CAPTCHA/reset continuation. Native registration and reset-token/MFA UI remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Community categories, text/voice channels, ordering, history, composer, context actions and settings.
features.evidence: Channel/category create, rename, topics, confirmed deletion, and permission-gated moves by category or sibling position. Drag-and-drop and full channel settings remain open. See STATUS.md and REVIEW.md.

features.acceptance: Language-aware code blocks, inline code, copy and supported language coverage.
features.evidence: Arborium highlighting with language aliases and plain-text fallback, inline code styling, and exact code-block Copy. See qa/chat3-rich-blocks.md for coverage and remaining GUI checks.

features.acceptance: Linked external accounts, verification, authorize/deauthorize and callback handling.
features.evidence: Linked account list, visibility edits and confirmed unlink with authoritative refresh. Authorized apps, creation and callback flows remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Developer tools, diagnostics and embed/component debugging.
Explore, filters, previews, join, visitor behavior and community listing management.
features.evidence: Native Explore directory with instance-scoped search, category/language filters, pagination and explicit confirmed joins. Visitor previews and listing management remain open. See qa/discovery.md.

features.acceptance: Unicode/custom emoji, aliases, animated emoji, skin tone and emoji rendering.
features.evidence: Bundled Unicode art with aliases and skin-tone selection, custom emoji, static/animated and jumbo chat rendering, and animation preferences. See CHAT_PARITY_2026_11_16.md for art coverage and live review gaps.

features.acceptance: Existing feature gates, experiment assignments and operator capabilities.
GIFs, stickers, custom emoji, saved media, favorites, expression assets and entitlements.
features.evidence: Native GIF search, synchronized URL favorite edits, and community stickers. Saved-media-backed editing remains open. See STATUS.md and REVIEW.md.

features.acceptance: Forum settings/tags, posts, sorting/filter/search, post creation, unread tracking and moderation.
features.evidence: Forum/media pagination and tag filtering, text post creation, staged attachments and media posts with source-compatible first-message upload metadata. Live permissions, upload failure/retry and moderation remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Identify, ready, heartbeat, resume/reconnect, dispatch reduction, lazy subscriptions and snapshots.
features.evidence: See STATUS.md; core/protocol/media foundations implemented, release acceptance incomplete.

features.acceptance: Gift redemption, purchase handoff and gift code lifecycle.
features.evidence: Native gift inventory with available and redeemed entries and explicit code copy for available gifts. Purchase, redeem, delivery and unread handling remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Community list and channel loading; M4 adds CRUD, roles, bans, audit log and integrations.
features.evidence: Native community creation, joins and leave, invite and channel administration, role definition CRUD, paginated audit log, bans and channel webhooks. Role ordering, richer audit changes and remaining settings need coverage. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Existing locale catalog coverage, pluralization, formatting, RTL and localized native menus.
features.evidence: Message timestamps and relative time use the account locale and hour-cycle preference through ICU on Linux. Locale catalogs, localized menus, RTL and cross-platform formatting remain open.

features.acceptance: Mentions, unreads, saved/pinned items, navigation and read state synchronization.
features.evidence: Unreads from current read state and server-backed Mentions with filters, pagination, retry and navigation. Saved and pinned items are outside the Inbox UI. Cross-client read-state review remains pending (REVIEW.md PUSH-E).

features.acceptance: Native editing, IME, clipboard, selection, multiline input, shortcuts and composition.
features.evidence: Native client implementation and tests; see STATUS.md for scope and release gaps.

features.acceptance: Resolve/preview/accept/create/revoke invites, vanity links, guest/login continuation.
features.evidence: Current-instance joins, community invite creation, list and confirmed revocation, and desktop invite links. See STATUS.md and REVIEW.md.

features.acceptance: Equivalent rich composer behavior, selections, mention/autocomplete, paste and undo.
features.evidence: Native selection, clipboard and undo/redo with keyboard and pointer completion for user, role, channel and emoji tokens. Real-account suggestions and physical IME acceptance remain open (REVIEW.md PUSH-C, U9 and U11).

features.acceptance: Members and roles for current communities; M4 adds management, search, chunking and hierarchy.
features.evidence: See STATUS.md; core/protocol/media foundations implemented, release acceptance incomplete.

features.acceptance: History, send/edit/delete/reply/reactions, live updates, attachments and delivery errors; rich rendering M3.
features.evidence: See STATUS.md; core/protocol/media foundations implemented, release acceptance incomplete.

features.acceptance: Reports, verification gates, mature content rules, bans/timeouts and safety flows.
features.evidence: Permission-gated kick, timeout, permanent ban, ban listing and revocation. Chat and forum views gate mature content and scoped warnings. Reports, regional gating and complete entry-point coverage remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Routes, back/forward, quick switcher, channel/message jump and deep-link targets.
features.evidence: Native Quick Switcher, channel/message navigation and Linux desktop links for home, channels, messages and invites. Broader route and navigation acceptance remains open. See STATUS.md and REVIEW.md.

features.acceptance: Mention/unread/sound policy, channel/guild overrides, desktop notification delivery and navigation.
features.evidence: Linux desktop delivery and click navigation, sounds, read/delete clearing, mute and notification-level overrides, and guild mention suppression. Actual OS and two-client acceptance remain open (REVIEW.md EXP-5 and NOV19B-3).

features.acceptance: Owner/admin, role hierarchy, everyone/role/member overwrites, implicit permissions and live invalidation.
features.evidence: Core permissions, permission-gated role management and role/member channel overwrite creation, editing and removal. Member picker uses loaded members. Full hierarchy/editor coverage and release acceptance remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Native OS ports, persistence, network/runtime policy, storage and platform capability boundaries.
features.evidence: Native client implementation and tests; see STATUS.md for scope and release gaps.

features.acceptance: Plutonium entitlements, subscription lifecycle, checkout returns, billing and Operator Pass.
features.evidence: Plutonium entitlement and perk status plus hosted gift inventory. Checkout, return, billing mutations and full gift flows remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Online/idle/DND/invisible, custom status, presence updates and suppression rules.
features.evidence: Gateway presence display, online/idle/DND/invisible selection, timed resets, custom text and emoji, and system-idle projection. Live timing, idle and cross-client acceptance remain open (REVIEW.md EXP-4).

features.acceptance: Channel read acknowledgments, mention counts, unread jumps and synchronization.
features.evidence: See STATUS.md; core/protocol/media foundations implemented, release acceptance incomplete.

features.acceptance: Friends, pending requests, add/remove, block/unblock and DM restrictions.
features.evidence: Friends tabs, pending request actions, remove/block/unblock, and DM entry points with gateway reconciliation. Populated live states and cross-client DM restriction behavior still require acceptance (REVIEW.md PUSH-D).

features.acceptance: Remote message search, filters, pagination, jump-to-message and quick switcher.
features.evidence: Server-backed search with source-query fixtures, historical jumps, filter suggestions, and scoped recent searches plus Quick Switcher. Full autocomplete, mature-content coverage and live acceptance remain open. See STATUS.md and REVIEW.md.

features.acceptance: Server-enforced slowmode countdown and permissions-aware send availability.
features.evidence: Per-channel countdown and composer send gating use local cooldowns, authoritative server retry timing and bypass permission. Live exemption and rejection behavior still require acceptance (REVIEW.md PUSH-C).

features.acceptance: Sensitive-info hiding, notification suppression, automatic process detection and shortcuts.
features.evidence: Device-local manual mode and independent privacy toggles, Linux capture-process detection, a dismissible status banner, name and invite masking in native views, and separate desktop notification and sound suppression. The shortcut in the acceptance inventory has no identified classic binding. Live desktop acceptance remains open.

features.acceptance: Terms/privacy acceptance, version gates and updated-terms continuation.
Native base palette, appearance and font/scale preferences; theme links and sharing M5.
features.evidence: Native client implementation and tests; see STATUS.md for scope and release gaps.

features.acceptance: Theme import/export, colors, fonts, local file watching and supported custom style semantics.
features.evidence: Device-local Dark and Coal presets applied to root and navigation surfaces. Full palettes, custom theme import/export and file watching remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Create/join/leave, roster, archive/lock, notifications, unread, browsing and side panels.
features.evidence: Active/archived browsing and public join/leave, private and message-started creation, owner archive/lock. Starter text, private membership and full moderator/read parity remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: External link confirmation, trusted-domain list and deceptive link handling.
features.evidence: External link warning can save an exact host after explicit consent. Trusted domains can be removed and cleared in settings. Full link settings and live acceptance remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Typing send throttling, incoming expiry and participant display.
features.evidence: See STATUS.md; core/protocol/media foundations implemented, release acceptance incomplete.

features.acceptance: Reusable native widgets, dialogs, menus, lists, tooltips and keyboard focus.
features.evidence: Native client implementation and tests; see STATUS.md for scope and release gaps.

features.acceptance: Distribution/channel policy, signed updates, download/progress/restart and rollback.
Profiles, preferences, account/security/devices, privacy, settings registry and applications.
features.evidence: Profile modal, own text and static avatar/banner edits, privacy preferences, and non-current session revocation with password, TOTP or backup-code proof. See STATUS.md, REVIEW.md and ACCOUNT_SESSIONS_SUDO.md.

features.acceptance: Native calls, microphone/playout, device/gain/DSP/PTT, screen/video/audio share, encryption and reconnect.
features.evidence: Community and private calls, microphone and playout, screen and application audio sharing, and Linux camera capture and receive. Device and live interoperability acceptance remains open.

features.acceptance: Create/edit/delete webhooks, secrets, channel destinations and integration views.
features.evidence: Channel permission-gated webhook list, copy URL, create, rename and confirmed delete. Avatar, destination changes and additional webhooks UI remain open. See STATUS.md.

features.acceptance: Window state, fullscreen, popouts, geometry and native lifecycle.
features.evidence: Native client implementation and tests; see STATUS.md for scope and release gaps.
